items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence (9 minute read)
items.snippet: Perplexity measures how well a model predicts the next token on average. Lower perplexity means better predictions. Perplexity has stood the test of time as a metric many research teams have put a lot of effort into optimizing. It will likely play an important role in standardizing how AI progress is discussed as it continues to deliver consistent gains in general intelligence.
